quote: In addition, multi-year awards from governmental customers may often only receive partial funding initially and may typically be cancelable on short notice with limited penalties.
why: 『multi-year awards』も『cancelable』で罰則は限定的。顧客は乗換の費用を負わない

quote: Globally, there are approximately 29,000 the Company PMS applications installed, which includes some sites using PMS products for which we have ceased ongoing development (although in many instances we continue to provide limited support services to those sites).
why: 設置数『29,000』と旧製品の継続利用を述べるだけで、顧客が乗換の費用を負うとは書いていない

quote: Because each vendor's products are proprietary, "drop-in replacement" devices are not available and the cost of switching to a different vendor's products after a system has been designed and prototyped is very high.
why: 『cost of switching』が設計・試作後は『very high』と断定。互換品が無く顧客が再設計を負うが再認定の記述はない

quote: We have invested in the past, and will continue to invest in the future, in merchandising and customer equipment consisting primarily of systems used by customers to dispense our products as well as to monitor water systems.
why: 『customer equipment』は当社が投資して据える分注装置で、費用は当社持ち。顧客が乗換の費用を負うとは述べていない

quote: We believe we have good relationships with our franchisees, as evidenced by our domestic franchisee renewal rate of 93% between 2007 and 2012.
mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: 『renewal rate of 93%』は加盟店との関係の証拠で更新は当社の選択。主顧客の消費者の乗換費用は述べていない

quote: Such programs extend for up to 17 years and totaled approximately $1.6 billion as of October 26, 2012.
why: 顧客との長期保守プログラムが『up to 17 years』、残高『$1.6 billion』と断定。複数年の購買義務に当たる

quote: Although we face competition from independent marketers for the sale of natural gas to our industrial and commercial customers, in instances where independent marketers displace us as the seller of natural gas, we still collect a distribution charge for transporting the gas through our distribution network.
why: 売り手を替えても『distribution network』経由で『distribution charge』を払い続ける＝配管による物理的固着

quote: Our products are often mission-critical equipment, which have been designed into particular military and commercial platforms and in certain cases can only be replaced by products of other manufacturers following a formal certification process.
why: 顧客の機体に『designed into』され、他社品への交換には『formal certification process』が要ると断定

quote: Many of these competitors have legacy client/server offerings that require relatively long implementation cycles and are difficult to displace in enterprise customers due to, among other reasons, switching costs.
why: 『switching costs』は競合の既存製品を守る側の話で、当社は置き換える外側にいる＝向きが逆

quote: We encounter significant competition across our product lines and in each market in which our products are sold.
why: 『significant competition』の一般的な競争記述のみで、乗換の費用や摩擦の機構を名指ししていない

quote: Our proprietary technology platforms operate only with our proprietary sensor lines.
why: 装置が『operate only with our proprietary sensor lines』と断定＝消耗品の専用性

quote: We believe that the cost and time required to obtain the necessary regulatory approvals significantly reduces the likelihood of a customer changing the manufacturing process it uses once a device or drug has been approved for sale.
why: 顧客側の『regulatory approvals』の費用と時間を名指しするが、『We believe』の推測で断定でないため85にしない
